exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie flat on the bench. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower under control to the mid-chest, then press back up to lockout.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically against the chest. Sit back and down, keeping the torso upright and elbows tucked. Drive through the heels to stand.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing away, hands slightly wider than shoulders. Pull the chin above the bar, lower under control to a full hang.
